projects.name: Contribuddha
projects.summary: The platform this planet runs on, building itself through its own protocol.

seat.reason: Built here. Both of its people are in San Diego County; the seat sits inland of them so the project and its builders read apart.

declared.note: The behavioural kernel is accepted and the coordination protocol runs; the product itself is still being built.

projects.name: Resonance
projects.summary: Shazam for human thought: discovering structural resonance between ideas through thought graphs and graph alignment.

seat.reason: Open research on how minds structure ideas belongs where that field is argued out.

declared.note: It works and is live: real people can try it, and a chat client can reach it over MCP.

projects.name: ExactlyHer
projects.summary: A commissioned build, delivered in full: the first work here paid for by someone outside the project.

seat.reason: The client who commissioned it is in France. The work is done in San Diego.

declared.note: Delivered in full to the client who commissioned it. The last commits landed the same day.

commission.covers: the whole job: every commit recorded on the project, and the work on it that no repository holds

delivered.note: Handed over complete. The pool was drawn down over the job and is settled in full.

settled.note: The money went through. Per-payment records are not connected to this page yet, so the settlement shown is the owner's account of it.

commission.note: Maximus commissioned the work and put the budget behind it; the project started because of it. Contribuddha takes its share off the top, and the rest is drawn down to the people doing the job as they do it.

work_off_record.note: Calls an agent is not allowed to make on its own.
Someone has to use it and say whether it is any good.
Judging what the models produced, which the models cannot judge.

projects.name: Corky
projects.summary: The corkscrew that talks back. A hardware project whose record lives in a workshop, not in a repository.

seat.reason: A corkscrew belongs to wine country. The workshop is in San Diego; the subject is here.

declared.note: The evaluation-kit prototype is built and working. The first ten units — the ones that look like the product — are being made now.
